In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Citizen science is a form of education, which aims at developing a broad and scientific mindset, and at fostering democratic engagement.

the term Citizen Science is used for a wide range of activities, from the simple participation of the public in scientific projects and activities to the more complex and sophisticated activities of civic educators, who work together with citizens to advance science and foster democratic engagement.

the main goal of our book is to provide the reader with a better understanding of citizen science and its potential to contribute to the advancement of science, to the development of a broad scientific mentality and to democratic engagement in society.

we have proposed a definition and a framework to classify the different types of citizen science, we have explained why this classification is important and we have shown that the classification is useful in understanding how different software solutions can support citizen science.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the meaning of terms and concepts used to refer to citizen science is not always as straightforward as one might think.
